generation_method: Built-in image_gen; first 16-pose atlas followed by one targeted full-body posture and foreleg edit.
inspection: Viewed full generated atlases and final 4x4 contact sheet at 2x nearest-neighbor size.
improvements_observed: Sixteen distinct whole-body drawings provide intermediate wing angles through the downstroke and recovery.
The selected second pass lowers the body into a more horizontal flying posture.
Front legs now hang softly below the chest rather than being curled up in front of it.
Horn-based rigid registration limits measured head landmark variation to approximately 0.54px horizontally and 0.27px vertically at delivery size.
All visible sprites fit within the 160x100 canvas with margins, and their full visible width is 99-102px.
Original generated alpha is retained in both source files; no color or alpha fringe was erased. Premultiplied-alpha resampling is used.
remaining_limits: The final-to-first transition retains some tail/hip silhouette change; its checkerboard-composited full-crop MAD is 8.90 versus 7.78 for the largest other adjacent transition. This is a flag for visual review, not proof of a bad loop by itself.
Small generated contour changes remain even with stable head registration.
Foreleg secondary movement is restrained; naturalness must be judged in the assembled moving banner.
recommendation: Use the relaxed second pass for V20 assembly, then visually review the native-size loop before calling it final.
